_comment: Dual-engine parity fixture `frequencies_30y` (phase 4, spec 11a). The 30-year worst case: horizon 2026-01-01..2056-01-01 = 361 monthly periods, three cadences interleaved — a biweekly salary (+14d walk, some months 2 occurrences, some 3) with 2%/yr growth, a weekly expense (+7d walk, 4 or 5 occurrences per month) with 3%/yr inflation, and an ANNUAL salary anchored on 2028-02-29 so the yearly walk exercises the Feb-29 leap-day occurrence clamp (2029-02-28, 2030-02-28, ..., 2032-02-29). With growth_policy none, the elapsed_years Feb-29 anniversary rule has no observable effect on these amounts — that rule is pinned cross-engine only at the JS unit level (preview_engine_dates.test.mjs), not by this fixture. Non-zero opening debt and portfolio keep net_worth = lc + pv - db honest. Also the node-side <150ms wall-clock budget fixture. `expected` is GENERATED by `rake forecast:parity:regenerate` and HAND-REVIEWED — never refresh blindly.
